decisions.reason: As a flagship Demeter range central to the firm's announced direction and publicly highlighted, escalation of commitment strongly favors persisting with this heavily invested product.
Although launched only in 2024, the firm has publicly presented it on its own page and invested in a line close to its established offer, so escalation of commitment leads management to keep it.
The firm has committed by launching and featuring this sliced butter cheese on its own page, and because sunk costs and public commitment weigh heavily, it is likely to persist.
